sources.snippet: NVIDIA has paired 32 GB HBM2 memory with the Tesla V100 SXM2 32 GB, which is connected using a 4096-bit memory interface. The GPU is operating at a frequency of 1290 MHz, which can be boosted up to 1530 MHz, memory is running at 877 MHz (1754 Mbps effective).
